description: This file declares functions related to quantization fusion and prepacking in PyTorch JIT. It includes declarations for fuse operations, insertion of prepacking/unpacking in computation graphs, and finalization of modules for quantized models, primarily focusing on the fbgemm backend and specific quantized ops.

methods.name: QuantFusion
methods.description: Performs fusion of dequantize-operation-quantize calls into a single quantized operation, primarily for the fbgemm backend and specific ops like conv2d and linear.

methods.name: InsertPrepackUnpack
methods.description: Inserts prepack and unpack functions into a given computation graph for quantized weights.

methods.name: InsertPrepackUnpack
methods.description: Traverses all graphs of a module and its submodules to insert prepack/unpack functions.

methods.name: Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes a module for quantization, supporting static quantization types.

methods.name: FoldQuantizedPrepackingOps
methods.description: Folds prepacking operations into the module to optimize quantized models.

methods.name: FinalizeOnDevicePTQ
methods.description: Performs finalization of a module for post-training quantization on a specific device.
